wim.title:
One critical signal.
Five disconnected systems.
Zero coordinated response.
wim.subtitle: Healthcare incidents don't wait for systems to catch up with each other — and when information stays fragmented, the response always arrives too late.
wim.card1.title: Delayed Incident Response
wim.card1.desc: A medical device fault reported in one system never reaches the pharmacovigilance team. By the time a pattern emerges, it is too late to prevent harm.
wim.card2.title: Cross-Domain Patterns Invisible
wim.card2.desc: The same molecule causes adverse events across three vigilance domains simultaneously — but no single system sees the full picture. The signal is lost in the silos.
wim.card3.title: Regulatory Compliance at Risk
wim.card3.desc: ANPP and CNPM require full traceability for pharmacovigilance and matériovigilance today — and chemical and cosmetic surveillance are catching up fast. Disconnected systems make staying ahead of compliance nearly impossible.
wim.card3.nonCompliant: NON-COMPLIANT — ANPP · CNPM · Ministry of Health
wim.anchor: VigiCore Nexus eliminates all three — in one unified platform.

vpanel.title: Five Vigilances. One Shield.
vpanel.desc: Each module is purpose-built for its domain — together, they form an unbreakable network of healthcare safety intelligence.
vpanel.pharma.desc: Monitors adverse drug reactions, medication errors, and side effects across the entire pharmaceutical supply chain. AI-driven pattern detection catches signals humans miss — before they become crises.
vpanel.materio.desc: Tracks medical device incidents, malfunctions, and near-misses. Real-time dashboards provide full traceability from device serial number to patient outcome — closing the feedback loop for manufacturers and authorities.
vpanel.chemo.desc: Surveillance of chemical, cytotoxic, and hazardous substance incidents in healthcare environments. Protects staff, patients, and communities from chemical exposure risks through intelligent monitoring and automated alerting.
vpanel.cosmeto.desc: Post-market surveillance of cosmetic products and their effects. Captures consumer and clinical adverse events, cross-references ingredient databases, and flags regulatory non-compliance before incidents escalate.
